context: Tests a Rust binary release where semantic-release owns signed Cargo version/tag preparation, cargo-dist alone owns immutable GitHub Release assets, and a custom signed publisher updates Homebrew.

checklist.name: Signed Cargo preparation
checklist.description: semantic-release uses a deterministic exec prepare step plus @jno21/semantic-release-github-commit@1.0.1 for existing Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock files, with commitMessage containing [skip ci].

checklist.name: Verified manifest commit
checklist.description: Plugin v1.0.1 runs only under an enforced exclusive-writer prepare interval, uses a scoped App token without custom identity, restores a credential-free origin immediately afterward, and the tag is proven to point to the verified Cargo version commit.

checklist.name: cargo-dist sole release owner
checklist.description: The semantic-release config omits @semantic-release/github and other asset publishers; cargo-dist's generated tag workflow alone creates the GitHub Release and uploads binaries.

checklist.name: Immutable release transaction
checklist.description: cargo-dist assembles the complete asset set before publication, then the workflow proves draft: false, immutable: true, gh release verify success, and expected asset names/digests.

checklist.name: Current cargo-dist workflow
checklist.description: The solution uses dist init/generate and its generated plan, build, host, publish, and announce workflow rather than a stale cargo-dist action or a build-only command.

checklist.name: Homebrew formula generation
checklist.description: dist configuration enables the Homebrew installer and names a homebrew- prefixed tap.

checklist.name: No unsigned built-in publisher
checklist.description: The config does not use built-in publish-jobs = ["homebrew"] when the tap requires signatures; it selects a custom post-announce reusable job instead.

checklist.name: Signed custom tap publisher
checklist.description: The custom post-announce workflow first verifies the exact published immutable Release, then commits only the generated formula through a full-SHA-pinned signed API action, with no local git commit/push or custom bot identity.

checklist.name: Scoped cross-repo token
checklist.description: The tap job reads source Release state with its source workflow token and mints a separate short-lived App token naming only the tap repository with least Contents permissions and no broad PAT.

checklist.name: Artifact source integrity
checklist.description: The formula derives URLs and checksums from the exact verified immutable release assets, not a rebuild or mutable workflow artifact.

checklist.name: Live parity readback
checklist.description: The workflow verifies source tag, Cargo versions, immutable release assets, tap formula version/digests, and tap commit signature all agree.

checklist.name: Durable recovery
checklist.description: The same reusable workflow has a validated manual recovery path keyed by exact tag and durable release/tap state, can repair missing tap parity after publication, and never mutates an immutable release.

checklist.name: History and action pins
checklist.description: Release checkout uses fetch-depth: 0 and high-trust actions are pinned to full commit SHAs with exact version comments.
